passages.note: Enrolled text removes the state handgun-carry license (rung 5 for a state officeholder); Pierce voted No, so it shows only his side against rung 5.
Bill details page lists authors and sponsors; Pierce is not named, so it records no act of his.
First-person newsletter calls for banning assault rifles (a ban on one class) alongside background checks and safe storage, as basic safety laws.

rows.reasoning: In his own newsletter Pierce faults the legislature for refusing to enact laws like "banning assault rifles", which matches "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons, while allowing other firearms"; a ban on one class is not a ban on civilian ownership, and wanting both checks and an assault-weapons ban goes past "Allow all types of firearms". His No on HB 1296 (2022), the permitless-carry law, is consistent but shows only the side.

quotes.text: Sadly, the legislature refuses to enact even the most basic safety laws like closing loopholes in background checks, instituting safe gun storage requirements and banning assault rifles.
I voted against that law because allowing people to carry concealed weapons without a permit puts Hoosiers at risk.
